newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Teacher's bulk saved two girls in Venezuela quake.
newsitem.headline: Teacher's bulk saved two girls in Venezuela quake.

text.p: Residents of this earthquake-devastated town in eastern Venezuela said on Friday they will remember teacher Madeleine de Sanchez for her bravery and for her bulk.
When Wednesday's quake, measuring 6.9 on the Richter scale, caused the roof to fall on her class de Sanchez swept two pupils into her arms.
Hours later, rescue workers found 10-year-old Maria Angelica and her friend, Gregoriana, under the 39-year-old teacher's body.
"She was this big," wept Angelica Maria as she stood up on her injured legs, stretching out her arms.
Forty-one bodies, many those of children, have been found in this Caribbean town of 13,000, leveled after Venezuela's worst earthquake in 30 years left at least 69 dead and 469 injured.
